name: Duplicati
description: Duplicati's updater retrieves a manifest from configured URLs, accepts it only when at least one configured RSA-SHA256 key verifies it, and checks retrieved package length and SHA-256 against signed manifest metadata. The reviewed code documents signature and hash checks; it does not by itself establish a fixed transport endpoint for every deployment.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; configured URL variants and installer-specific behavior were not exhaustively compared.
